decisive_spans.text: Prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states 'Prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat' and 'Right bundle-branch block present', which are direct support for His-Purkinje Disease. While AV Block is also supported by the prolonged HV interval, His-Purkinje Disease is a more specific diagnosis that encompasses both the prolonged HV interval and the right bundle branch block.
